events.nextSeasonHeading: Stay Tuned for the Next Season
events.nextSeasonText: Event dates and artists for the upcoming concert season are announced each year around October. Sign up to be the first to know — and to secure your table before they're gone.

pastEvents.label: Past Season Highlight
pastEvents.title: Piano Nights at Bellini
pastEvents.imageAlt: Grand piano concert at Bellini — aerial view, red carpet, audience dining
pastEvents.text1: From solo pianists to four-hand duos, Bellini's piano evenings have become some of the most sought-after nights in the city. Past performances include Piano Trilogy, Schubert & Ravel — Piano 4 Hands, and solo recitals by Etienne Chenevier.
pastEvents.text2: Guests dine at their tables as the music fills the open-air garden — intimate, unhurried, and completely unexpected for Phnom Penh. Every edition has sold out.

pastEvents.label: Past Season Highlight
pastEvents.title: Miles Davis Nights — Jazz at Bellini
pastEvents.imageAlt: Jazz band performing live at Bellini garden, Phnom Penh
pastEvents.text1: A jazz ensemble performing Miles Davis classics — Kind of Blue, Summertime, and more — in the open-air garden, to a packed crowd dining under the trees. Blue lights, warm evenings, and music that fills the space without crowding it.
pastEvents.text2: The jazz nights draw a mix of expats, locals, and visitors from across the city. Multiple editions have sold out entirely — reserving well in advance is essential.

pastEvents.label: Past Season Highlight
pastEvents.title: Opera, Dance & Cultural Evenings
pastEvents.imageAlt: Live performance on stage at Bellini open-air garden, Phnom Penh
pastEvents.text1: Bellini's stage has welcomed opera (Carmen, performed multiple seasons), the Phnom Penh Singers, Princess Buppa's Khmer classical dance, and the Atkinson Brothers — 2 Pianos. Each event brings something the city rarely sees, set against the backdrop of the garden.
pastEvents.text2: These evenings sell out fast. Following Bellini on Facebook is the best way to catch announcements early.
